correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the weak flip criterion Delta E_v=2 sigma_v(h-J sum neighbors sigma), whose neighbor sums are ±1,±3; tested field representatives t=0,1,2,3,4. The cyclic rung word is bijective with length-n closed walks of the explicit 16-state transition matrix, for every n>=3, with no division by rotational orbit. Independently rebuilt exact integer transfer matrices and symbolic characteristic polynomials: x^10(x-1)(x+1)(x^2-x-1)(x^2+x+1), x^7 P3 P6, x^12(x^2-x-1)(x^2+x+1), x^13(x+1)(x^2-2x-1), x^15(x-1). Their traces yield every stated count. The critical 11-state recurrent component and characteristic root rho≈2.33935824 support Perron asymptotics and both spike heights.
